# RadioKit In-App Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server

RadioKit is an open-source alternative to RemoteXY for building wireless UI controllers for Arduino and ESP32. The Flutter companion app embeds a native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server over HTTP/SSE on port 7007.

## Base URL & Transport

- Transport: HTTP Server-Sent Events (SSE)
- SSE Endpoint: `http://<app-ip>:7007/sse`
- Messages Endpoint: `http://<app-ip>:7007/messages?sessionId=<sessionId>`
- Port: `7007`

## Quick Start (MCP)

1. Connect to SSE stream at `GET /sse` to receive session endpoint.
2. Send JSON-RPC `initialize` message to `POST /messages?sessionId=<sessionId>`.
3. Discover tools with `tools/list` and execute them via `tools/call`.
4. Read dynamic device telemetry from resources (`radiokit://console`, `radiokit://widgets`, `radiokit://fs`, `radiokit://diagnostics/connection`, `radiokit://packets`, `radiokit://devices`).

## 68 Registered MCP Tools

### Connection & Multi-Device
- `radiokit_scan_devices` - Scan for BLE and serial devices
- `radiokit_connect` - Connect via BLE, Serial, WiFi, or Cloud (supports skipConf)
- `radiokit_disconnect` - Disconnect from active or target device
- `radiokit_get_connection_status` - Query connection state and latency
- `radiokit_get_connection_diagnostics` - Discovered GATT services, characteristics, CCCD, MTU, and connection events
- `radiokit_retry_handshake` - Manually trigger widget configuration handshake
- `radiokit_list_active_devices` - List devices in active multi-device pool
- `radiokit_switch_device` - Change active focus in multi-device pool

### Pairing & History
- `radiokit_reconnect` - Reconnect to recent or saved device
- `radiokit_get_paired_devices` - List all paired devices in local history
- `radiokit_forget_device` - Remove device from history
- `radiokit_clear_paired_devices` - Clear paired device history

### Diagnostics & Raw Packet Snoop
- `radiokit_get_packet_log` - Retrieve raw TX/RX frames with sub-protocol classification and CRC checks
- `radiokit_send_raw_packet` - Inject raw byte frames directly over active transport

### Widgets & Pages
- `radiokit_list_widgets` - List all widgets and current input/output values
- `radiokit_get_widget` - Get state of a specific widget
- `radiokit_set_widget` - Set input value for a widget (buttons, sliders, joysticks)
- `radiokit_get_pages` - List available UI pages
- `radiokit_set_page` - Switch active UI page
- `radiokit_clear_widgets` - Clear widget layout

### Filesystem (LittleFS)
- `radiokit_fs_list` - List files and directories
- `radiokit_fs_info` - Storage statistics (used, total, free)
- `radiokit_fs_read` - Read file content (text or Base64)
- `radiokit_fs_write` - Write file data
- `radiokit_fs_delete` - Delete file or directory
- `radiokit_fs_mkdir` - Create directory
- `radiokit_fs_format` - Format filesystem partition
- `radiokit_fs_rename` - Rename or move file
- `radiokit_fs_probe` - Probe LittleFS readiness

### OTA Updates
- `radiokit_ota_upload` - Upload firmware binary or .zip bundle (with force option)
- `radiokit_ota_cancel` - Abort in-progress OTA
- `radiokit_ota_status` - Get OTA progress status

### Device Config & NVS
- `radiokit_nvs_get` - Read device name, description, and auth mode
- `radiokit_nvs_set` - Save config to Non-Volatile Storage
- `radiokit_nvs_authenticate` - Verify connection password
- `radiokit_reboot` - Reboot connected MCU
- `radiokit_factory_reset` - Erase NVS configuration and reboot
- `radiokit_nvs_raw_write` - Write raw NVS key/value

### Transport Diagnostics
- `radiokit_transport_ping` - Measure round-trip ping latency
- `radiokit_transport_wifi_info` - Query device WiFi status
- `radiokit_transport_quick_cmd` - Send single-byte command

### Serial Flasher
- `radiokit_flasher_scan` - Scan USB serial ports
- `radiokit_flasher_flash` - Direct serial firmware flashing
- `radiokit_flasher_status` - Flasher progress state
- `radiokit_flasher_erase` - Erase MCU flash
- `radiokit_flasher_clear_log` - Clear flasher logs

### Visual Designer
- `radiokit_designer_list`, `radiokit_designer_get`, `radiokit_designer_save`, `radiokit_designer_delete`, `radiokit_designer_duplicate`, `radiokit_designer_import`, `radiokit_designer_export`, `radiokit_generate_design_header`, `radiokit_designer_parse_header`

### Cloud Relay
- `radiokit_cloud_status`, `radiokit_cloud_connect`, `radiokit_cloud_disconnect`, `radiokit_cloud_list_accounts`, `radiokit_cloud_create_account`, `radiokit_cloud_delete_account`, `radiokit_cloud_switch_account`, `radiokit_cloud_get_device_info`

### App Settings & Session
- `radiokit_get_settings`, `radiokit_update_settings`, `radiokit_get_session_state`, `radiokit_clear_api_logs`

## 13 Live MCP Resources

- `radiokit://console` - Live MCU serial console logs
- `radiokit://widgets` - Active widget tree & hierarchy
- `radiokit://fs` - LittleFS directory structure
- `radiokit://diagnostics/connection` - Live connection & GATT diagnostics
- `radiokit://packets` - Real-time raw packet trace buffer
- `radiokit://devices` - Multi-device pool status
- `radiokit://models` - Saved paired models and profiles
- `radiokit://designs` - Saved designer layout templates
- `radiokit://session` - Companion app session & route state
- `radiokit://app-log` - Remote API invocation logs
- `radiokit://flasher/log` - Serial flasher console logs
- `radiokit://docs` - Documentation index
- `radiokit://docs/<skill>` - Skill documentation content
